game.name: Ride to Hell : Retribution (USA, Europe)
game.desc: Ride to Hell: Retribution on Xbox 360 follows Jake Conway as he seeks revenge on The Devil's Hand biker gang. Like any good beat'em all, you'll be able to use your fists, firearms and even some of the scenery to defeat your enemies.
